test: dotnet build InventoryManagementSystem.sln after retargeting both projects to net8.0
actual: Build succeeded. 0 Error(s) (36 pre-existing nullable-reference warnings in ConsoleApplication, unrelated to the retarget)

test: Start the web app against Docker SQL Server on first run (empty database)
expected: DbInitializer creates schema, seeds admin user and demo data with exact row counts 6/6/30/30/40/1
actual: Log: 'Row counts - Categories: 6, Suppliers: 6, Products: 30, Stocks: 30, StockTransactions: 40, Users: 1'; app reached 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5080' with no errors

test: GET /Product without a session
actual: HTTP 302, redirect_url=http://localhost:5080/Account/Login?returnUrl=%2FProduct

test: POST /Account/Login with admin/Admin@123 and a valid antiforgery token
actual: HTTP 302, redirect_url=http://localhost:5080/Dashboard

test: GET /Dashboard with an authenticated session
actual: HTTP 200; grep confirmed the text 'Inventory Value' present

test: Authenticated GET across Category, Product, Supplier, Stock and all 5 Report routes with filter query strings (/Category, /Product?categoryId=1, /Supplier, /Stock?status=Low, /Stock/StockIn?productId=2, /Report/ProductCatalog?supplierId=2, /Report/StockSummary?status=Out, /Report/LowStock, /Report/TransactionHistory?type=StockOut, /Report/InventoryValue?categoryId=3)
expected: All 10 routes return 200, no errors/exceptions/'could not be translated' lines in the app log
actual: All 10 returned 200; grep -c for error|exception|could not be translated over the app log during the sweep returned 0

test: POST /Stock/StockOut with quantity=99999 on a product with 42 in stock
expected: Rejected with 'Insufficient stock. Available: {n}', stock quantity unchanged
actual: Response contained 'Insufficient stock. Available: 42'; sqlcmd confirmed dbo.Stocks.QuantityAvailable for that product was still 42 after the attempt

test: POST /Stock/StockIn with quantity=-5
expected: Rejected with a 'must be greater than zero' message
actual: Response contained 'Quantity must be greater than zero.'

test: POST /Category/Delete/1 for a category with products assigned to it
actual: HTTP 302 redirect back to /Category (TempData error set in DeleteConfirmed); sqlcmd confirmed COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Categories WHERE CategoryId=1 was still 1 after the attempt. (The TempData banner itself isn't visible yet in this reduced-scope pass since _Alerts.cshtml/_Layout.cshtml were written but not re-verified visually after the PWA integration.)

test: POST /Account/ChangePassword with an incorrect current password
actual: Response contained 'Current password is incorrect.'

test: Full round trip: change admin's password to NewPass456, log in with it, change it back to Admin@123, log in with the original again
expected: Both changes succeed, both logins succeed (302 to /Dashboard)
actual: 'Password changed successfully.' on both changes; login with NewPass456 -> 302 /Dashboard; login with Admin@123 afterward -> 302 /Dashboard

test: GET /manifest.json and /sw.js

test: Authenticated GET /api/stock/low
